proposals.before: His wife, Lady Shi, was a younger sister of Gaozu's daughter.
proposals.after: His wife, Lady Shi, was a younger sister of Emperor Gaozu of Jin.
proposals.reason: 女弟 means younger sister, not the younger sister of a daughter; 晉高祖之女弟 is Gaozu of Jin's own younger sister.

proposals.before: His wife, the Lady Shi, was the younger sister of a daughter of Emperor Gaozu of Jin.
proposals.after: His wife, the Lady Shi, was a younger sister of Emperor Gaozu of Jin.
proposals.reason: 女弟 is younger sister of 晉高祖, not of a daughter of Gaozu.

proposals.before: Before a reply came he hurried on the road. The court could not stop him, and he was at once appointed military governor of Yedu.
proposals.after: Before a reply came he hurried on the road. The court could not stop him, and he was at once appointed regent of Yedu.
proposals.reason: 鄴都留守 is the stay-behind / regent of the Ye capital, not a 節度使 military governor.

proposals.before: Before a reply came he hurried on the road. The court could not stop him, and he was at once appointed military governor of Yedu.
proposals.after: Before a reply came he hurried on the road. The court could not stop him, and he was at once appointed stay-behind governor of Yedu.
proposals.reason: 鄴都留守 is stay-behind governor of Yedu, not military governor.

proposals.before: Zhongwei appeared before Gaozu in plain dress. Gaozu pardoned Zhongwei and appointed him acting Grand Tutor with concurrent appointments as Grand Preceptor and Director of the Secretariat.
proposals.after: Zhongwei appeared before Gaozu in plain dress. Gaozu pardoned Zhongwei and appointed him acting Grand Preceptor, probationary Grand Tutor, and concurrent Director of the Secretariat.
proposals.reason: Chinese order is 檢校太師、守太傅、兼中書令: Taishi then Taifu then Zhongshuling, not Taifu first with Taishi bundled as concurrent.

proposals.before: Zhongwei appeared before Gaozu in plain dress. Gaozu pardoned Zhongwei and appointed him acting Grand Tutor with concurrent appointments as Grand Preceptor and Director of the Secretariat.
proposals.after: Zhongwei appeared before Gaozu in plain dress. Gaozu pardoned Zhongwei and appointed him acting Grand Preceptor, probationary Grand Tutor, and concurrent Director of the Secretariat.
proposals.reason: 檢校太師 is acting Grand Preceptor; 守太傅 is probationary Grand Tutor; 兼中書令 is concurrent Director of the Secretariat.

proposals.before: After Gaozu died the death was kept secret. The ministers jointly executed Zhongwei and his sons Hongzhang, Hongcan, and Hongqiao. Their bodies were exposed in the market. Townspeople kicked and reviled them. Officers could not restrain them. The corpses were torn apart and trampled until in a moment nothing remained.
proposals.after: After Gaozu died the death was kept secret. The ministers jointly executed Zhongwei and his sons Hongzhang, Hongcan, and Hongsui. Their bodies were exposed in the market. Townspeople kicked and reviled them. Officers could not restrain them. The corpses were torn apart and trampled until in a moment nothing remained.
proposals.reason: 弘璲 is Hongsui (sui), not Hongqiao.

proposals.before: When the Khitan invaded, the Deposed Emperor twice went in person to Chanzou. Du Zhongwei was northern campaign commander and Shouzhen was overall supervisor.
proposals.after: When the Khitan invaded, the Deposed Emperor twice went in person to Chanzhou. Du Zhongwei was northern campaign commander and Shouzhen was overall supervisor.
proposals.reason: 澶州 is Chanzhou; Chanzou is a typo.

proposals.before: When the Khitan invaded, the Deposed Emperor twice went in person to Chanzou. Du Zhongwei was northern campaign commander and Shouzhen was overall supervisor.
proposals.after: When the Khitan invaded, the Deposed Emperor twice went in person to Chanzhou. Du Zhongwei was northern campaign commander and Shouzhen was overall supervisor.
proposals.reason: 澶州 is Chanzhou; the literal field repeats the Chanzou typo.

proposals.before: Supervising Ma Quanjie's army, he defeated Li Jinquan at Anzhou and was made commissioner of the palace secretariat for his merit.
proposals.after: Supervising Ma Quanjie's army, he defeated Li Jinquan at Anzhou and was made commissioner of the palace domestic service for his merit.
proposals.reason: 宣徽使 is the Xuanhui / palace domestic-service commissioner, not the palace secretariat (樞密).

proposals.before: Zhao Siwen had already rebelled at Jingzhao and sent someone with an imperial-yellow robe to Shouzhen. Shouzhen was greatly pleased, thinking heaven and men both responded. He raised troops, seized Tong Pass in the west, and recruited bandits, who rose everywhere.
proposals.after: Zhao Siwan had already rebelled at Jingzhao and sent someone with an imperial-yellow robe to Shouzhen. Shouzhen was greatly pleased, thinking heaven and men both responded. He raised troops, seized Tong Pass in the west, and recruited bandits, who rose everywhere.
proposals.reason: 趙思綰 is Zhao Siwan (綰 wan), not Siwen.

proposals.before: Shi reached Binzhou. The prefect supported him with troops. Military Governor Li Zhou of Bin retained him, sent fast riders to report the matter, and an edict exiled Shi to Shangzhou.
proposals.after: Shi reached Yanzhou. The prefect supported him with troops toward the gate of Binzhou. Military Governor Li Zhou of Bin retained him, sent fast riders to report the matter, and an edict exiled Shi to Shangzhou.
proposals.reason: Chinese has 衍州 then 邠州; rendering both as Binzhou collapses two prefectures.

proposals.before: The mother of Prince Yanshu, Lady Ding of Chu, was beautiful. Yanze sent men to request her from the Empress Dowager. When the Empress Dowager hesitated, he seized her by force.
proposals.after: The mother of Prince Yanxu, Lady Ding of Chu, was beautiful. Yanze sent men to request her from the Empress Dowager. When the Empress Dowager hesitated, he seized her by force.
proposals.reason: 皇子延煦 is Yanxu (煦 xu), not Yanshu.

decisions.after: Lady Shi, his wife, was a younger sister of Gaozu, the Jin emperor.
decisions.reason: 女弟 means Gaozu's younger sister; the existing English incorrectly makes her the sister of Gaozu's daughter.

decisions.reason: The source separates 衍州 from 邠州. A corrupt 門 has replaced punctuation in the local Chinese text; it does not mean that troops escorted Shi toward a gate.
